subject: EOQ pilot top-off — conditional credit to secure Dedicated conversion
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@brightwing.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EOQ pilot top-off — conditional credit to secure Dedicated conversion

Emma — great call today. Quick follow-up with a concrete, timeboxed offer to help BrightWing finish the pilot and accelerate the move to Dedicated for production. High level:

- One-time credit: $20,000 in token/usage credit applied to BrightWing account upon commit to a Dedicated 3-month minimum (Deal BW-2026-1127).
- Validity: credit must be consumed within 45 days of issuance; offer expires 2027-01-09 (EOQ close window).
- Conditions: conversion executed (signed terms + initial invoice paid) by 2027-01-31; credit is non-transferable and not redeemable for cash.

Attached is a short one-page summary and a sample amendment that legal would sign off on. If this looks good to you I’ll loop in Laura/Vivek for internal approval and route DocuSign after we lock the final numbers.

Next step: are you comfortable sharing a short procurement timeline (PO sign date target) so we can align the DocuSign window?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0119

Attachment: brightwing-offer-summary.pdf (PDF)
From: Emma Li <emma@brightwing.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 08:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: EOQ pilot top-off — conditional credit to secure Dedicated conversion

Thanks Sean — appreciate the quick proposal and the clarity.

Two things from my side: 1) Procurement wants the offer documented (line items + expiration). 2) We’ll need a short note about data residency and audit logging commitments included in the amendment (standard for our security/compliance team).

High-level timeline from BrightWing: PO + legal sign-off by 2027-01-20 if we can get a clean amendment and the DocuSign link by end of week of Jan 3. If you can do the credit with the 45-day consumption window that should work for us.

Looping Raj from procurement (copied) — Raj, happy to sync if you need a quick call.

—Emma
Emma Li
Head of ML Platforms — BrightWing AI
emma@brightwing.ai

Subject: Request: quick approval for conditional $20k credit for BrightWing (BW-2026-1127)

Laura / Vivek —

Quick ask: BrightWing is asking for a one-time $20k usage credit to push the pilot into a Dedicated conversion before EOQ. Key deal facts:
- ARR if converted: ~$180k/year (3-month Dedicated commit)
- Closed-won likely within 30–45 days if we provide a documented credit + amendment (procurement OK with Jan 20 PO target)
- Proposed credit: $20,000, consumption window 45 days, expires if conversion not executed by 2027-01-31

I’ve attached the one-pager I shared. Customer has security questions but their timeline is tight. My ask: can we approve $20k as a deal sweetener? If yes I’ll prepare the DocuSign amendment and route to finance for invoicing cadence.

Thanks — Sean

Attachment: brightwing-offer-summary.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: quick approval for conditional $20k credit for BrightWing (BW-2026-1127)

Sean — thanks for the concise ask and context. I’m supportive of an EOQ-focused incentive here but want to tighten the terms:

- Approve up to $20,000 credit, but prefer $15,000 as the operational cap unless Sean can justify the extra $5k based on firm conversion signals (PO received, legal redlines minimal).
- Credit must be issued only after finance confirms initial invoice has been paid (no retro-credit).
- Add a clause: credit will be void if contract changes materially post-sign (e.g., scope increase).

If you can confirm PO timeline and push for the $20k ask from BrightWing (showing the lift to ARR), I’ll sign off $20k contingent on finance confirming the payment step. Please attach a short approval CSV for ops so Vivek can process quickly.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: approval-notes.csv (CSV)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Credit allocation confirmed (conditional) — BrightWing (BW-2026-1127)

Emma / Raj —

Thanks for the quick dialogue. Per Laura’s note, Redwood will provision a conditional one-time usage credit: $20,000 allocated to BrightWing, pending the following:
1) Signed amendment (DocuSign) and initial invoice payment.
2) Conversion executed (Dedicated commit) by 2027-01-31.
3) Credit consumption within 45 days of issuance.

Operational steps I’ve taken:
- HubSpot: updated deal BW-2026-1127 with credit line and custom property (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/BW-2026-1127).
- DocuSign: drafting amendment and will send to Emma + Raj by 2027-01-03.
- Finance: flagged for invoice verification prior to issuing credit.

Emma — I’ll send the DocuSign link when it’s live. Please keep us posted if procurement timing shifts; we can adjust the DocuSign window but the conversion cutoff stays 2027-01-31.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
